collection_instructions: Collect at least 20 groups and at least 100 total pairs.
After adjudication, retain at least 50 same-event and 50 different-event pairs.
Every group must contain both pair classes; use near-time, same-entity, or same-topic hard negatives rather than easy unrelated negatives.
Include multiple publishers, event types, geographies, and publication-time gaps; do not let one event family dominate the packet.
Keep full source title, URL, publisher, publication time, and enough original or licensed context for a reviewer to decide event identity.
Assign opaque article and pair ids. Keep collection order unrelated to the expected decision and do not add automated scores or predictions.
Resolve disagreements by evidence-backed adjudication; uncertainty stays explicit and does not count toward either class minimum.

instructions: Collect article pairs in groups built around one anchor event.
Each group must contain plausible same-event pairs and hard different-event pairs.
Strip automated similarity scores, cluster ids, and predicted pair decisions.
Reviewer A and reviewer B label each pair independently.
Reveal both reviews to the adjudicator only after both independent reviews are final.

source_annotations.notice: Existing source annotations were produced or checked only by automation. They are untrusted, excluded from reviewer tasks, and must not be reconstructed before independent review.
